items.title: 프라다부터 모스키노까지, 2027 S/S 밀라노 여성 패션위크 라인업 공개
items.summary: WWD Korea's Milan Fashion Week lineup piece confirms Demna's second Gucci ready-to-wear show for September 25 at 2pm, positioned as one of the week's most closely watched slots alongside Prada's opening show. Frames the show as a test case for whether Demna's creative reset is gaining traction a year into his tenure; descriptive scheduling piece, not yet a review.

items.title: 디자이너, CEO도 바꿔도 비틀대는 구찌, 1분기 매출 -8%
items.summary: Korean business press reports Gucci's Q1 2026 revenue fell 8% to EUR1.347 billion despite the CEO and creative-director changes, with Europe down 7% and Asia down 6% (Japan hit hardest at -14%). Frames the figures as evidence that leadership change alone has not reversed the 12-consecutive-quarter decline. Retained despite being outside the ideal freshness window because it is the most recent quantified earnings data point still actively cited in this week's NEA discussion threads.

items.source: Sina Fashion Hourly (新浪时尚热点小时报)
items.title: 新浪时尚热点小时报丨2026年09月23日01时
items.summary: Sina's fashion news digest includes a consumer-guidance segment ranking Gucci among higher-volume luxury brands (with Louis Vuitton) that lose comparatively less resale value after refurbishment (roughly 15-25% price reduction) versus steeper depreciation at Hermes and Chanel. Neutral, informational framing embedded in a broader luxury resale-value roundup.

items.title: 古驰大降价+新总监首秀，能重现辉煌吗？3个维度深度解读+FAQ
items.summary: Weibo FAQ-style analysis post on Gucci's dual strategy of steep China price cuts (up to 40%, e.g. Mercato tote CNY25,500 to CNY20,000) and Demna's creative reset via the 'La Famiglia' debut. Comment threads are split: some welcome the narrower price gap with overseas markets and view it as good timing to buy entry pieces, others read repeated markdowns after 12 straight quarters of decline as confirmation the brand overpriced itself and is now chasing value-conscious shoppers rather than restoring desirability.

items.title: 비쌀수록 잘 팔린다더니...이제 아무도 안 사, 추락하는 명품
items.summary: Korean community news-board thread on the broader luxury slowdown, singling out Gucci's 12 consecutive quarters of declining sales alongside LVMH's roughly 35% stock drop this year. Top comment argues luxury brands lost mystique once manufacturing realities (production by workers in developing countries rather than artisans) became widely known, questioning why consumers would keep paying premium prices; thread shows heavy engagement with 93,732 downvotes recorded alongside just 5 upvotes, indicating strong controversy/disagreement in the reply chain.

items.title: 中國降價救銷量？奢侈品牌Gucci包包、成衣 售價降40%
items.summary: Chinese-language North America outlet reports Gucci's China price cuts of 30-40% on bags and apparel as an attempt to revive sales amid slowing global luxury growth (down to 1.6% in 2025 from 26% in 2021). Cites the Kering CEO's admission that 'pricing power has diminished and some products were overpriced, hurting sales.' Notes social media users expressed little surprise, pointing out Louis Vuitton and Miu Miu have also quietly cut some prices — suggesting the move reads as an industry-wide retreat rather than a Gucci-specific correction.

items.title: "할머니 집 같아" 탄식...구찌 매장 '폐쇄 선언' 초유의 사태
items.summary: Reports Kering's 'ReconKering' restructuring plan to close roughly 125 Gucci stores globally by 2030, about half of all planned Kering-wide closures. Quotes a Kering executive attributing Gucci's struggles partly to dated store design, with some locations described as looking 'like grandmother's houses.' Notes Gucci accounts for about 40% of group revenue, making its continued underperformance an outsized drag on Kering overall. Retained past the ideal freshness window as it remains the most substantive sourced quote on store-network problems still being referenced in current NEA commentary.
